bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's booking page, or by email to reservation@konstantinfilippou.com. Tables can be booked up to six months ahead.
cancellation: Card details (Mastercard or Visa) are needed to confirm a booking. Cancel by email at least 48 hours ahead, Monday to Friday during opening hours, or €200 a person is charged (€80 at lunch).
waitlist: Ask for a place on the waiting list by email to reservation@konstantinfilippou.com.
groups: Parties of five or more book by email. A private dining room seats up to 16, and events outside opening hours can be arranged on request.
children: Children are welcome if they can enjoy the tasting menu; chicken or pasta can be made if ordered ahead. The restaurant is not suited to babies and toddlers.
duration: About three and a half hours for the dinner tasting menu.
